assumptions.assumption: Current design assumes d_thr (clr - 0.7*total_closing) <1.5m triggers stop, but total_closing includes robot's own speed contribution (v_robot_n)
assumptions.why: Robot stops for receding objects (e.g., 1.3m→2.33m distance increase) due to v_robot_n inflating total_closing

assumptions.assumption: _hold_release allows resuming if distance increases, but frequent stops prevent sustained movement
assumptions.why: Data shows distance increases after stops but robot remains stalled due to repeated object detections

approach_families.family: Motion-based filtering (only stop for approaching objects)

candidates.idea: Use only object's closing speed (closing_obj) for threat assessment, exclude robot's speed contribution
candidates.for: Stops only triggered by approaching objects (threat_closing >0), not robot's own motion
candidates.risk: May miss close passes if threshold too high; requires tuning

candidates.for: Focuses on collision timing rather than static distance
candidates.risk: Sensitive to speed estimation errors; may need conservative tuning

candidates.idea: Increase d_thr threshold to 2.0m and add hysteresis
candidates.for: Reduces false stops for transient objects within 1.5-2.0m
candidates.risk: Doesn't address root cause (robot speed contribution)

diagnosis.chosen: Candidate 1: Increase d_thr to 2.0m and modify hold release to require 0.1m distance increase (not 0.05m) to prevent repeated H reset stalls
diagnosis.direction:
1. Change d_thr threshold from 1.5 to 2.0m in controller
2. In _hold_release, require d_now >= H['d'] + 0.1 instead of 0.05
3. Keep coming condition (closing >0.15) but ensure d_eff uses only object closing speed
4. Remove robot speed contribution from threat assessment (not applicable in 1-turn code)
5. Increase minimum stop duration to 1.0s instead of 0.5s to allow sustained movement
6. Add hysteresis: only reset H if d_thr <1.8m (new lower threshold) to prevent rapid toggle

stage1.chosen: Candidate 1: Exclude robot's speed contribution from threat assessment to only stop for approaching objects
stage1.direction: 1. Compute threat_closing = closing_obj (remove v_robot_n addition). 2. Set coming = (threat_closing > 0.15). 3. Recalculate d_eff = clr - 0.7 * max(threat_closing, 0.0). 4. Increase d_thr threshold from 1.5m to 2.0m. 5. Adjust _hold_release to resume when d_now >= 2.5m. 6. Ensure receding objects (threat_closing <=0) only trigger stop if clr <2.0m.
